_note: B-30. Credential levers on the mock tenant (PowerShell module CredentialOps). The generated value goes only to the out-of-band file under .tmp/oob (core/levers/oob.py), never into the result, queue, audit, notice or prompt. Mock only; no real Entra call.

levers.name: user.reset-password
levers.description: Issue a new one-time password to the out-of-band channel and force a change at next sign-in. The value is never shown here. Refuses accounts holding a directory role. Mock of a Graph password reset.

upn.description: userPrincipalName of one user of this client

impact.L1: One person gets a new password from a technician by another channel; a wrong target or impostor locks them out or lets an attacker in.
impact.L2: The client's account for one user changes; a social-engineered reset is a breach of client data.
impact.L3: An identity change the MSP must justify to auditors: callback on file, the client's authorized contact, two lead approvals, an audit record without the secret.
impact.L4: Password help is the most common lockout fix and the step attackers talk their way through; one careful path at every client protects everyone.

levers.name: user.new-tap
levers.description: Issue a single-use Temporary Access Pass with the shortest lifetime the tenant policy allows, to the out-of-band channel. The value is never shown here. Refuses accounts holding a directory role. Mock of a Graph Temporary Access Pass.

upn.description: userPrincipalName of one user of this client

impact.L1: One person gets a one-time pass from a technician by another channel to sign in and re-register; a wrong target or impostor gets a working sign-in.
impact.L2: A pass is a working sign-in for the client's account until used or expired; the shortest lifetime limits that window.
impact.L3: An authentication-method change the MSP must justify: callback on file, the client's authorized contact, two lead approvals, an audit record without the pass.
impact.L4: A short, single-use pass lets locked-out people recover without a shared secret in a ticket, which protects every client.
